Chapter 965  Chapter 23 Inner Universe (Please Subscribe)

The cosmic void is ripping apart on a large scale, unveiling scenes after scenes of the Chaos Void.

Under the watchful eyes of the nine strongest beings of human civilization, in just a brief moment, a fissure spanning tens of thousands of light-years was torn open.

And this was only the beginning.

With each passing moment, this fissure crazily expanded.

Ten thousand light-years.

Fifty thousand light-years.

One hundred thousand light-years.

Two hundred thousand light-years.

...

Vast and overwhelming pressure poured into the universe, carrying the aura of the Chaos Void Origin.

"Galaxy Master..."

Even though the nine strongest beings of human civilization had anticipated it, they thought the Galaxy Master's surge to the ultimate power would certainly not be insignificant.

After all, the last time Lin Yuan attempted to ascend to Level Eleven, the fissure he created connecting to the Chaos Void spanned hundreds of light-years, no less significant than a normal Level Eleven Perfect's surge to the ultimate.

But the moment he began his ascension attempt, the cosmic fissure surpassed two hundred thousand light-years and continued to expand at an alarming rate, leaving the nine strongest beings unable to calm their thoughts.

After a full breath of time had passed.

The wild expansion of the cosmic fissure gradually halted, finally stabilizing around one million light-years.

"One million light-years?"

The Xuanyuan Supreme took a deep breath.

When they attempted their ascensions, the cosmic fissures they tore open were only hundreds of light-years wide, but the Galaxy Master's reached one million light-years?

One hundred light-years and one million light-years.

On the surface, they seem only ten thousand times apart.

But in reality, the imminent influx of the Chaos Void Origin will result in a difference of millions to tens of millions of times due to the ten-thousand-fold gap in the cosmic fissures.

"This is terrifying."

The Void God Ultimate Being couldn't believe it. How much Chaos Void Origin could pour through a one-million-light-year fissure? Such an immense influx of Chaos Void Origin could burst the inner cosmos of a newly advanced Level Twelve.

"What kind of profound foundation is required to rip open such an enormous cosmic fissure?"

The Ancient Power Supreme Being muttered to himself that when surging to the ultimate power, the cosmic fissure is completely dependent on one's own capability.

Until now, the strongest beings of human civilization never had an intuitive understanding of Lin Yuan's profound foundation. They only knew that Lin Yuan was incredibly strong, with a life essence unbelievably powerful, able to drag another Level Twelve through the river of time.

But profound foundation?

Profound foundation is related to the essence of life, yet it is not entirely the same.

And now, the one million light-years cosmic fissure highlighted that the Galaxy Master's profound foundation had reached an unprecedented level. Not even the combined might of all Level Eleven Perfect beings who have ever attempted the ascension since the universe's inception could match a ten-thousandth of the Galaxy Master's.

"Actually, the Galaxy Master surging to the ultimate power doesn't require our protection at all..."

The Feather Butterfly Supreme Being said, as the cosmic fissure was instantly torn open, with the overwhelming pressure of the Chaos Void protecting the Galaxy Master.

With the current pressure of the Chaos Void surrounding the Galaxy Master, isn't it impossible for the ultimate beings of the Path Splitting Realm at Level Twelve to get close?

As for those two ultimate beings of the Path Splitting Realm at their peak from the Robber Clan?

Originally they were already despised by the cosmic will, and if they dare to approach at this time, they would likely face the crushing suppression of the universe's full force.

The other eight strongest beings nodded, the Feather Butterfly Supreme Being was not wrong; not to mention those alien Level Twelve beings who cannot get close, even they could not approach themselves.

Advancing further means facing the suppression of the Chaos Void Origin.

The cosmic fissure torn open by the Galaxy Master surging to the ultimate power connects to the Primordial Lands of the Chaos Void.

The Primordial Lands of the Chaos Void, the core of the Chaos Void itself, are sheltered by the will of the Chaos Void. Even opening up a slight gap is unapproachable by any but the being making the ascension attempt, let alone daring to approach it.

...

The ultimate beings of the pinnacle races of various powers are also paying close attention to this scene of the Galaxy Master's surge to the ultimate power.

"A one million light-years cosmic fissure? No wonder the Galaxy Master could suppress Tianyu Chen; I've never even heard of such a terrifying profound foundation."

The ultimate voice from the Star Alliance was somber; these Level Twelve ultimates were originally worried if the Galaxy Master might be secretly surging to the ultimate power.

But now it seems there's no need for such concerns; the commotion of the Galaxy Master's surge to ultimate power is too great, not just they, but even those Level Eleven and Level Ten powerhouses can sense it.

"I've never heard of it either."

"I've once received some messages from outside the universe, which also never recorded such a monstrous being."

Many surrounding Level Twelve ultimates found it incomprehensible.

However, with the prior scene of Lin Yuan suppressing Tianyu Chen, everyone's level of acceptance increased greatly.

Though they did not understand, they quickly accepted it.

"With such a strong foundation, will the Galaxy Master really fail to surge to the ultimate?"

One of the Level Twelve ultimates expressed his doubt. Facing the Galaxy Master now, all they could do was wait for his attempt to surge to the ultimate power to fail.

Only in this way, could they resolve the Galaxy Master without effort, returning the situation amongst the universe's pinnacle races to a balance.

But upon seeing the cosmic fissure the Galaxy Master opened at the start of his surge to the ultimate, some Level Twelves began to feel puzzled.

Will such a powerful being really die from trying to surge to the ultimate power?

Or, to say, will the backlash from the river of time and the universe really be capable of thwarting the Galaxy Master during his surge to the ultimate power?

"Now we have no other choice."

"We can only hope for the Galaxy Master's failure."

The ultimate being of the Prison Tribe shook his head, mentioning that even before the Galaxy Master attempted to surge to the ultimate, they were already incapable of dealing with him, let alone now that the Galaxy Master is trying to surge to ultimate power, protected by the Chaos Void Origin.
